overview.zh: 桌面按 packet type 接收 P4 上行状态、反馈、故障、安全、标定和诊断包。schema 为多数包规定 4 字节时间戳，CALIB_DIAG/TASK_DIAG 除外；解码端仍需核对长度、字段范围及新鲜度。
overview.en: The desktop dispatches P4 uplink state, feedback, fault, safety, calibration, and diagnostic packets by type. The schema assigns a 4-byte timestamp to most types except CALIB_DIAG/TASK_DIAG; decoders must still check size, field ranges, and freshness.

zh.plain: 上行 packet 目录定义桌面如何识别 P4 回包、读取状态/遥测/故障/诊断，并将有效字段交给对应模型。
zh.condition: 进入条件是串口接收器读到帧并识别 type；字段布局由共享 schema 与 decoder 决定。
zh.effect: 按 packet type 选择 decoder；大多数类型含 P4 timestamp，CALIB_DIAG/TASK_DIAG 是协议注明的例外。
zh.failure: 未知 type、错误长度或无效字段不能成为可信状态更新。
zh.recovery: 核对 packet type、decoder、timestamp 与协议 schema 版本。
zh.unknown: 目录结构不能证明串口上有实时回包或反馈足够新鲜。
zh.difference: 上行方向是 P4 发给桌面；下行 commands 是桌面发给 P4。
zh.change: 基线未标记该 packet 目录为本次变更。

en.plain: Uplink packet catalog defining how the desktop identifies P4 replies and routes state, telemetry, fault, and diagnostic fields to their models.
en.condition: Entered when the serial receiver reads a frame and recognizes its type; shared schema and decoder define field layout.
en.effect: Dispatches by packet type; most types include a P4 timestamp, while CALIB_DIAG/TASK_DIAG are schema-defined exceptions.
en.failure: Unknown type, wrong length, or invalid fields cannot become a trusted state update.
en.recovery: Check packet type, decoder, timestamp, and protocol schema revision.
en.unknown: The catalog does not prove live replies or fresh feedback on the serial link.
en.difference: Uplink travels from P4 to desktop; downlink commands travel from desktop to P4.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this packet catalog as changed.

zh.plain: PACKET_TYPE_SENSOR (type 1) 携带sensor数据；协议描述：21 关节映射角。
zh.condition: 共享 schema 定义 type=1；payload 前含 4 字节 P4 timestamp。
zh.effect: 接收器按 type=1 分流到 PACKET_TYPE_SENSOR parser，再把解码字段写入对应状态/显示项。
zh.failure: 类型命中后仍需通过长度、字段范围和 freshness 检查，否则不应更新当前状态。
zh.recovery: 跳转该 packet parser 核对解码字段、长度与 state 写入点，再对照 P4 同版 schema。
zh.unknown: type 常量不证明包当前正在到达，也不证明传感器值准确。
zh.difference: PACKET_TYPE_SENSOR 有独立 payload contract，不应按其它 packet type 解读。
zh.change: 基线未标记该 packet type 为本次变更。

en.plain: PACKET_TYPE_SENSOR (type 1) carries sensor data in its dedicated uplink decoder.
en.condition: Shared schema defines type=1; payload includes a 4-byte P4 timestamp prefix.
en.effect: The receiver dispatches type=1 to the PACKET_TYPE_SENSOR parser and writes decoded fields to the corresponding state/view.
en.failure: A recognized type must still pass length, field-range, and freshness checks before updating current state.
en.recovery: Open the packet parser to inspect fields, length, and state writes, then compare with the matching P4 schema.
en.unknown: The type constant does not prove live arrival or accurate sensor values.
en.difference: PACKET_TYPE_SENSOR has a distinct payload contract and must not be interpreted as another packet type.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this packet type as changed.
